about: A leading supplier of industrial cutting, sewing, embroidery, pressing, and laundry equipment, along with genuine and OEM parts for this equipment, as well as sewing threads. We provide expert technical support backed by decades of industry experience.
Established in 2002, Mark Middle East L.L.C. provides sewing machines and parts to a customer base across the Middle East, Africa, Asia and the European Union.
